model.name: facetType.deriveViewKind
model.description: A single-source pure fn maps an element's ior-class to its diagram facet-type (UseCase->UmlUseCase / Method->UmlMethod|UmlFunction / Class->tsClass / ModelElement->model.kind / unknown->null fail-closed), so a dropped UseCase renders as an ellipse not a class box. Both server add-view (derive+store, 400 on null) and client renderFacet fallback import the SAME fn = no divergent 'class' default.
